assumptions.operatingPoint: Specified steady-state pressure levels and superheat, not measured True T-19-HC performance.
assumptions.capillaryPressureProfile: 16 uniformly spaced prescribed pressure samples. Fraction is process progress, not physical pipe distance or residence time.
assumptions.circuitSampleFractions: Within-stage interpolation coordinates are process progress, not geometric length or transient travel time.
assumptions.qualityDefinition: Vapor mass fraction in equilibrium two-phase PH flash, not vapor volume fraction; null outside saturation.
assumptions.capillarySuctionHeatExchangerNote: Actual product arrangement unconfirmed. A coupled heat-transfer model is required for future support.
assumptions.suctionHeatSource: Ambient heat gain, separate from useful cabinet evaporator cooling.
assumptions.pressureLosses: Neglected outside prescribed capillary pressure drop.
assumptions.condenserEnergyBalance: qCondenser=qEvap+suctionHeat+shaftWork; motor loss separate from refrigerant heat.
